prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit this game UI icon atlas into hand-painted INK-WASH silhouettes. Preserve EXACTLY the twenty subjects, positions, sizes, orientation, five-column/four-row equal-cell grid and generous empty gutters. Do not change any symbol into a full-body person. Change the treatment and reverse the polarity: BLACK AND GRAY INK SYMBOLS ON PURE SOLID WHITE BACKGROUND. Background must be uniform white without paper grain so it can be keyed out for a parchment UI.
Art direction: original fantasy manuscript action glyphs, hand-brushed with charcoal-black pooled pigment in heavier lower strokes and soft smoky gray ink washes in the upper/interior strokes. Broad visible tonal variation INSIDE EACH symbol, fluid irregular transitions, tiny dry-brush breaks and slightly ragged nib edges. Retain a strong recognizable silhouette with dark contour strokes, essential interior cutouts and confident simple shape language. The sword should look drawn in ink, not like a rendered metal sword. Suggest ink soaking into paper through irregular pigment density, not cast shadows or 3D lighting. Broad texture features that survive reduction to 40px; avoid tiny scattered noise. Restrained old engraved-book hatching within broad shapes only.
Exact order stays: row1 sword, arrow, shield, bear, power sword; row2 curved feint sword, targeted arrow, shackle pinning arrow, empty hood, shadow dagger; row3 water extinguishing flame, pushing palm, low sweeping trip sword, paw, roaring bear head; row4 boot prints, face with return arrow, arrows bundle, flaming arrow, hourglass.
NO metallic sheen, gold, color, bevel, rim lighting, glow, drop shadow, smooth computer-generated gradient, frames, labels, text, new symbols or decorative splatters outside icons. Strong ink print identity, grayscale only, all icons isolated entirely within their original cells. The attached image is the composition and subject reference, not the desired medium.
